capacity.label: Recognised Monthly Receipts
capacity.definition: Average monthly self-employed operating receipts recognised from the customer’s accounts. Own-account transfers, loan disbursals, refunds and unverified credits are excluded.

capacity.label: Post-commitment Cash Remaining
capacity.definition: Average money remaining after operating outflows, regular expenses and verified debt payments have been deducted from recognised receipts.

capacity.label: Verified Debt Outstanding
capacity.definition: Total outstanding amount from operating and personal borrowing facilities visible in the available verified records.

capacity.label: Accessible Financial Reserves
capacity.definition: Savings and deposits available as a financial reserve. The ₹7.80L operating current-account balance is shown in Financial Position but is not automatically treated as personal savings or a freely available reserve.

metrics.label: Recognised self-employed receipts
metrics.definition: Monthly business credits accepted as operating receipts after transfers, financing inflows, refunds and unresolved credits are excluded.
metrics.calculation: Sum eligible business receipts for each month.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Interpret the absolute amount against this customer’s prior comparable period and an approved self-employed cohort.
metrics.assessment: Average recognised receipts are ₹4.88L across the latest six months and recovered after July.
metrics.evidence: IDBI and covered bank-account transactions · 12 completed months

metrics.label: Self-employed receipt growth
metrics.definition: Change in recognised receipts versus the relevant prior comparable period.
metrics.calculation: (Current comparable receipts − prior comparable receipts) ÷ prior comparable receipts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Positive growth is the configured directional benchmark; seasonal businesses use the same-season baseline.
metrics.assessment: Receipt growth turned negative in July and recovered in August and September.
metrics.evidence: Recognised monthly receipt series · customer baseline

metrics.label: Expected receipt periods met
metrics.definition: Whether recognised business receipts were observed in each expected earning period.
metrics.calculation: Eligible periods with recognised receipts ÷ expected earning periods.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Receipts should be visible in at least five of the latest six expected months.
metrics.assessment: Business receipts were visible in all six recent months.
metrics.evidence: Recognised monthly receipt series · expected monthly cadence

metrics.label: Self-employed receipt variation
metrics.definition: Variation of recurring business receipts around their recent average.
metrics.calculation: Robust variation across comparable monthly recognised receipts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Variation at or below 25% is the configured demo benchmark.
metrics.assessment: Variation remained within the benchmark despite the July reduction.
metrics.evidence: Recognised monthly receipt series · 12 completed months

metrics.label: Largest payer share
metrics.definition: Share of recognised receipts attributable to the largest identifiable payer.
metrics.calculation: Largest verified payer receipts ÷ total recognised receipts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Lower payer concentration reduces reliance on one counterparty; the threshold requires segment calibration.
metrics.assessment: The largest identified payer represents 35% of recent receipts.
metrics.evidence: Counterparty-resolved business credits · partial payer identification

metrics.label: Operating expense ratio
metrics.definition: Verified operating outflows as a share of recognised business receipts.
metrics.calculation: Verified business operating outflows ÷ recognised business receipts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: The configured demo benchmark expects operating outflows to remain at or below 60% of recognised receipts.
metrics.assessment: Operating expenses exceeded the benchmark in July and subsequently improved.
metrics.evidence: Classified business debits · transfers and debt payments excluded

metrics.label: Discretionary spending share
metrics.definition: Flexible household spending as a share of classified household spending.
metrics.calculation: Discretionary spending ÷ total classified household spending.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: This metric is interpreted against the customer’s own pattern and is not an adverse judgement.
metrics.assessment: Discretionary spending remained broadly consistent with the customer’s recent pattern.
metrics.evidence: Classified household debits · classification confidence shown in details

metrics.label: Total expense change
metrics.definition: Change in classified operating and household expenses versus the prior comparable window.
metrics.calculation: (Current comparable expenses − prior comparable expenses) ÷ prior comparable expenses.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: An increase of 5% or less is the configured demo benchmark; verified exceptional expenses are separated.
metrics.assessment: Expenses increased materially in July and reduced in the following two months.
metrics.evidence: Classified operating and household debits · comparable windows

metrics.label: Cash remaining before debt
metrics.definition: Recognised receipts remaining after verified operating and recurring non-debt outflows.
metrics.calculation: Recognised receipts − operating expenses − recurring household non-debt expenses.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: The configured amount benchmark is based on the demo customer profile and requires bank calibration.
metrics.assessment: Cash available before debt fell below the benchmark in July and recovered strongly.
metrics.evidence: Recognised receipts and classified non-debt outflows

metrics.label: Post-commitment surplus margin
metrics.definition: Share of recognised receipts remaining after operating outflows, regular expenses and verified debt payments.
metrics.calculation: Cash remaining after commitments ÷ recognised receipts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Retaining at least 20% after commitments is the configured demo benchmark.
metrics.assessment: The surplus margin recovered after falling below the benchmark in July.
metrics.evidence: Recognised receipts · classified expenses · verified debt payments

metrics.label: Positive-surplus month
metrics.definition: Whether the monthly post-commitment cash position was non-negative.
metrics.calculation: Recognised receipts minus operating expenses, household expenses and verified debt payments.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: At least five positive-surplus months in the latest six is the configured benchmark.
metrics.assessment: Five of the latest six months had positive cash remaining after commitments.
metrics.evidence: Monthly post-commitment cash series

metrics.label: Essential-payment returns
metrics.definition: Count of verified essential non-debt payments returned for insufficient funds.
metrics.calculation: Count eligible returned essential payments by month.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: No verified essential-payment return is the configured benchmark.
metrics.assessment: One essential-payment return was recorded during the July cash-flow reduction.
metrics.evidence: Return reason and classified essential-payment records

metrics.label: Verified debt outstanding
metrics.definition: Current outstanding across deduplicated covered loan and revolving facilities.
metrics.calculation: Sum current outstanding across canonical covered facilities.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Outstanding is interpreted with income, purpose, repayment and limit information.
metrics.assessment: Verified outstanding reduced gradually during the assessed period.
metrics.evidence: IDBI facilities and covered external obligations · deduplicated

metrics.label: Monthly debt payments
metrics.definition: Verified monthly loan, card and other debt payments due.
metrics.calculation: Sum monthly contractual debt payments across covered facilities.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: The absolute payment is interpreted through repayment share and debt-service coverage.
metrics.assessment: Recorded monthly debt payments remained stable at approximately ₹88,000.
metrics.evidence: Covered facility schedules and observed payments

metrics.label: Debt repayment share
metrics.definition: Verified monthly debt payments divided by recognised receipts.
metrics.calculation: Monthly verified debt service ÷ recognised receipts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Debt payments at or below 40% of recognised receipts are the configured demo benchmark.
metrics.assessment: Debt payments remain below the configured share-of-receipts benchmark.
metrics.evidence: Recognised receipts · covered monthly debt service

metrics.label: Debt service coverage
metrics.definition: Cash available before debt divided by verified monthly debt payments due.
metrics.calculation: Pre-debt cash remaining ÷ monthly debt service.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: At least ₹1.25 available for every ₹1 due is the configured benchmark.
metrics.assessment: Coverage fell below the benchmark in July and recovered strongly.
metrics.evidence: Pre-debt cash series · covered monthly debt service

metrics.label: Maximum days past due
metrics.definition: Highest verified days past due among covered facilities during the month.
metrics.calculation: Maximum verified DPD across eligible facility cycles.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Zero days past due is the contractual benchmark.
metrics.assessment: The current position is 0 DPD; earlier monthly due-versus-paid history is unavailable.
metrics.evidence: Current facility status · historical cycles incomplete

metrics.label: Current overdue amount
metrics.definition: Verified unresolved overdue amount across covered facilities.
metrics.calculation: Sum unresolved overdue balances across covered facilities.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: No unresolved overdue amount is the contractual benchmark.
metrics.assessment: No current overdue amount is reported in the available records.
metrics.evidence: Current covered facility status

metrics.label: Revolving and working-capital utilisation
metrics.definition: Verified revolving outstanding divided by the corresponding sanctioned limits.
metrics.calculation: Total covered revolving outstanding ÷ total covered revolving limit.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Utilisation at or below 70% is the configured demo benchmark.
metrics.assessment: Aggregate utilisation is material but remains within the configured benchmark.
metrics.evidence: Covered revolving facilities · facility purpose partly unresolved

metrics.label: Debt burden change
metrics.definition: Change in debt-payment-to-receipt ratio versus the prior comparable period.
metrics.calculation: Current repayment share minus prior comparable repayment share.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: A stable or reducing burden is the configured directional benchmark.
metrics.assessment: The repayment burden reduced as receipts recovered in August and September.
metrics.evidence: Repayment share series · customer baseline

metrics.label: Accessible financial reserves
metrics.definition: Verified cash, eligible deposits and accessible investments after operating, pledged and locked funds are excluded.
metrics.calculation: Sum eligible accessible balances after approved exclusions and haircuts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Interpret the absolute amount against commitments and an approved comparable cohort.
metrics.assessment: Accessible reserves recovered to ₹6.40L after the July drawdown.
metrics.evidence: Covered balances and investments · ₹7.80L operating balance excluded

metrics.label: Reserve coverage
metrics.definition: Months of regular commitments covered by accessible financial reserves.
metrics.calculation: Accessible reserves ÷ average monthly core expenses and debt payments.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Three months of covered commitments is the configured demo benchmark.
metrics.assessment: Reserve coverage improved to 1.8 months but remains below the benchmark.
metrics.evidence: Accessible reserves · regular expenses · covered debt payments

metrics.label: Average monthly savings retained
metrics.definition: Cash retained after recognised receipts, regular expenses and debt payments, excluding own-account transfers.
metrics.calculation: Recognised receipts − classified expenses − verified debt payments − net investment redemptions.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: The amount corresponds to the configured 10% savings-rate benchmark for this demo profile.
metrics.assessment: Average savings retained remains below the configured amount benchmark.
metrics.evidence: Reconciled monthly cash-flow series

metrics.label: Savings retained rate
metrics.definition: Average savings retained as a share of recognised receipts.
metrics.calculation: Monthly savings retained ÷ recognised receipts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: A 10% retained-savings rate is the configured demo benchmark.
metrics.assessment: The savings-retained rate remains below the configured benchmark.
metrics.evidence: Recognised receipts and reconciled retained savings

metrics.label: Monthly investment contributions
metrics.definition: Verified recurring contributions to deposits, mutual funds, pension or other eligible investments.
metrics.calculation: Sum verified investment contributions net of reversals.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: ₹25,000 per month is the configured demo benchmark for this customer profile.
metrics.assessment: Regular investment contributions continued through the assessed period.
metrics.evidence: Covered investment and deposit contribution records

metrics.label: Investment contribution change
metrics.definition: Change in verified investment contributions versus the prior comparable period.
metrics.calculation: (Current contributions − prior comparable contributions) ÷ prior comparable contributions.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Stable or increasing contributions meet the directional demo benchmark.
metrics.assessment: Contributions remained regular but reduced slightly in September.
metrics.evidence: Monthly verified contribution series

metrics.label: Reserves compared with recent high
metrics.definition: Current accessible reserves divided by the highest balance in the latest six months.
metrics.calculation: Current accessible reserves ÷ six-month peak accessible reserves.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Maintaining at least 80% of the recent reserve high is the configured benchmark.
metrics.assessment: Reserves recovered above the benchmark after the July decline.
metrics.evidence: Monthly accessible reserve series

metrics.label: Reserve recovery after drawdown
metrics.definition: Amount recovered since the latest trough as a share of the preceding reserve decline.
metrics.calculation: Recovery from trough ÷ preceding peak-to-trough drawdown, capped at 100%.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Recovering at least 75% of the latest drawdown is the configured demo benchmark.
metrics.assessment: The July drawdown has recovered by approximately 84%.
metrics.evidence: Monthly accessible reserve series

metrics.label: Operating-account liquidity
metrics.definition: Eligible cash available for business operations after financing proceeds and restricted balances are excluded.
metrics.calculation: Eligible operating-account balance after approved exclusions.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: A benchmark cannot be assigned until the customer’s minimum operating requirement is confirmed.
metrics.assessment: Operating liquidity is visible but is not treated as personal savings.
metrics.evidence: Business current account · operating requirement pending

metrics.label: Low operating-balance days
metrics.definition: Days the eligible operating balance fell below the provisional business requirement.
metrics.calculation: Count days below the approved or provisional operating-liquidity requirement.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: No days below the operating requirement is the configured benchmark once the requirement is confirmed.
metrics.assessment: No low operating-balance day was observed in September; the operating requirement remains provisional.
metrics.evidence: Daily operating balance series · provisional requirement

metrics.benchmarkNote: Colours compare each value with the stated benchmark. All thresholds and values are simulated demonstration settings; production use requires approved bank policy, cohort calibration and source-coverage controls.

metrics.label: Recognised monthly salary
metrics.definition: Verified employer salary credits after reversals, transfers and reimbursements are excluded.
metrics.calculation: Sum verified salary credits in the month.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Compare with prior salary and an approved occupation and geography cohort.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no verified salaried-income profile is used for this customer.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when recurring employer salary is verified.

metrics.label: Salary growth
metrics.definition: Change in fixed salary versus the prior comparable period.
metrics.calculation: (Current fixed salary − prior fixed salary) ÷ prior fixed salary.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: A non-negative direction is shown for demo; cohort calibration is required.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no verified salaried-income profile is used for this customer.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when recurring employer salary is verified.

metrics.label: Salary receipt continuity
metrics.definition: Whether salary arrived within the expected monthly salary window.
metrics.calculation: Expected salary months received on time ÷ expected salary months.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Requires an approved salary-window tolerance.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no verified salaried-income profile is used for this customer.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when recurring employer salary is verified.

metrics.label: Variable-pay share
metrics.definition: Share of recognised employment income from bonus, commission or other variable pay.
metrics.calculation: Verified variable pay ÷ total verified employment income.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Used to interpret income predictability; it is not inherently adverse.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no verified employment-income mix is available.
metrics.evidence: Applicable to salaried customers with variable compensation.

metrics.label: Recognised monthly pension or annuity
metrics.definition: Verified recurring pension or annuity receipts.
metrics.calculation: Sum verified pension and annuity credits in the month.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Compared with prior receipts and documented entitlement.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no verified pension or annuity source is used.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when pension or annuity is a material recurring resource.

metrics.label: Pension-to-expense coverage
metrics.definition: Recurring pension and annuity income relative to essential monthly expenses.
metrics.calculation: Verified pension and annuity receipts ÷ essential expenses.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Recurring pension should cover essential expenses without regular asset liquidation.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no verified pension or annuity source is used.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when pension or annuity is a material recurring resource.

metrics.label: Planned reserve withdrawal rate
metrics.definition: Annualised planned withdrawals as a share of eligible retirement reserves.
metrics.calculation: Annualised planned withdrawals ÷ eligible retirement reserves.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Requires age, horizon and product-specific policy calibration.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because planned retirement drawdown is outside this customer’s scope.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when regular living expenses are funded from retirement assets.

metrics.label: Recognised foreign income
metrics.definition: Verified foreign-currency income translated using the approved monthly FX rate.
metrics.calculation: Eligible foreign income × approved period FX rate.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Assessed against comparable-currency history and an approved NRI cohort.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because the customer is not assessed under an NRI or multi-currency profile.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when material income is denominated in foreign currency.

metrics.label: FX-adjusted income change
metrics.definition: Change in foreign income after holding currency conversion on a comparable basis.
metrics.calculation: Change in constant-currency eligible foreign income.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Separates underlying income change from exchange-rate movement.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no material foreign-currency income is verified.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when material income is denominated in foreign currency.

metrics.label: Domestic commitment coverage from remittances
metrics.definition: Verified remittances available for India commitments relative to those commitments.
metrics.calculation: Eligible India-bound remittances ÷ verified domestic commitments.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Requires approved treatment of remittance timing and retained overseas funds.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no recurring foreign-to-India remittance pattern is verified.
metrics.evidence: Applicable when foreign remittances fund domestic needs or obligations.

metrics.label: Guardian funding continuity
metrics.definition: Whether verified guardian funding arrived in each expected period.
metrics.calculation: Expected guardian-funding periods received ÷ expected periods.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Requires a verified guardian and documented funding expectation.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because this customer is assessed as an adult with independent resources.
metrics.evidence: Applicable to a minor or financially dependent customer.

metrics.label: Protected savings balance
metrics.definition: Verified savings legally or operationally designated for the dependent.
metrics.calculation: Sum eligible protected savings after ownership and access checks.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Compared with documented purpose, time horizon and approved policy.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because dependent or guardian-funded assessment does not apply.
metrics.evidence: Applicable to a minor or financially dependent customer.

metrics.label: Same-season receipt growth
metrics.definition: Change in recognised seasonal receipts versus the same verified season in the prior cycle.
metrics.calculation: (Current-season receipts − prior same-season receipts) ÷ prior same-season receipts.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Uses the customer’s verified earning cycle rather than month-on-month comparison.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no verified seasonal or agricultural earning cycle is supplied.
metrics.evidence: Applicable where income follows a crop or other non-monthly cycle.

metrics.label: Off-season commitment coverage
metrics.definition: Months of regular commitments covered during the verified low-income season.
metrics.calculation: Eligible off-season reserves ÷ average monthly off-season commitments.
metrics.benchmarkDefinition: Coverage should span the customer’s verified low-income season.
metrics.assessment: Excluded because no verified seasonal or agricultural earning cycle is supplied.
metrics.evidence: Applicable where income follows a crop or other non-monthly cycle.

financialHealthDetail.calculationSummary: For this individual, self-employed customer, the score combines recognised operating receipts, household and operating outflows, verified debt, and accessible personal reserves. Operating-account funds are assessed separately and are not automatically treated as personal savings.

drivers.name: Income & Receipt Reliability
drivers.facts: ₹4.88L average receipts · 6/6 expected months · 14% variation · largest payer 35%
drivers.assessment: Recognised self-employed receipts are consistent, reasonably diversified and strong for the assessed customer profile.
drivers.definition: Combines receipt scale, continuity, variation and payer concentration into one view of income reliability.
drivers.evaluation: Receipt amount is interpreted against the customer’s history and comparable self-employed customers. Continuity, variation and payer concentration then test whether that income is dependable.
drivers.evidence: Covered bank-account transactions for 12 completed months. Own-account transfers, loan disbursals, refunds and unresolved credits are excluded.

drivers.name: Expense & Operating Load
drivers.facts: 45% operating expense ratio · 17% discretionary share · expenses down 2% · 0 recent payment returns
drivers.assessment: Regular operating and household outflows remain manageable. The July increase has reduced and no recent essential-payment return is visible.
drivers.definition: Combines operating costs, household spending, expense movement and essential-payment failures into one view of recurring outflow pressure.
drivers.evaluation: Operating and household expenses are classified separately, then assessed as ratios and trends so a high absolute spend is not judged without reference to receipts.
drivers.evidence: Classified operating and household debits across covered accounts. Transfers and debt payments are separated before assessment.

drivers.name: Cash Remaining & Recovery
drivers.facts: ₹2.11L before debt in Sep · 50% post-commitment margin · positive in 5/6 months · recovered after July
drivers.assessment: The customer usually retains meaningful cash after regular commitments, and the temporary July reduction recovered in August and September.
drivers.definition: Combines cash remaining before debt, post-commitment surplus and recovery after a weak month into one view of monthly financial capacity.
drivers.evaluation: Both the rupee amount and the share of receipts are considered. Positive-surplus frequency prevents one strong month from masking a weak pattern.
drivers.evidence: Recognised receipts less classified operating, household and verified debt commitments. July was the only weak month in the recent six-month window.

drivers.name: Debt Burden & Affordability
drivers.facts: ₹36.75L outstanding · ₹88,000 monthly payments · 15% repayment share · 4.4× Sep coverage
drivers.assessment: Verified debt payments are currently affordable relative to recognised receipts and cash remaining before debt.
drivers.definition: Combines debt outstanding, scheduled payments, repayment share and debt-service coverage into one affordability view.
drivers.evaluation: The assessment considers the size of debt together with actual repayment demand and available cash. A large loan is not treated as weak when repayment capacity is strong.
drivers.evidence: IDBI facility balances, reported limits and covered-account repayment debits. Complete external-lender coverage is pending.

drivers.name: Repayment Conduct
drivers.facts: 0 current DPD · ₹0 currently overdue · complete historical due-versus-paid cycles unavailable
drivers.assessment: No current repayment stress is reported. The conclusion remains qualified because full historical payment-cycle evidence is not available.
drivers.definition: Combines current delinquency, overdue amount and available payment-cycle history into one view of repayment behaviour.
drivers.evaluation: Current status is considered alongside historical due-versus-paid evidence. Missing history cannot be interpreted as good conduct.
drivers.evidence: Current facility status is covered. Full historical due dates, paid dates and payment-return cycles are incomplete.

drivers.name: Revolving & Working-Capital Use
drivers.facts: 59% utilisation · debt burden down 3 percentage points · no verified new obligation
drivers.assessment: Working-capital use is material but remains within reported limits, and the repayment burden has not increased in the recent period.
drivers.definition: Combines revolving utilisation, burden direction and new borrowing into one view of reliance on working-capital debt.
drivers.evaluation: Utilisation is assessed against sanctioned limits and its direction over time. Persistent high use or increasing debt would weaken the result.
drivers.evidence: Aggregate IDBI limits and balances. Facility-level purpose and any external revolving exposure require confirmation.

drivers.name: Accessible Reserve Strength
drivers.facts: ₹6.40L accessible reserves · covers 1.8 months · benchmark 3 months
drivers.assessment: Accessible personal reserves are positive but below the configured three-month benchmark. The ₹7.80L operating-account balance is assessed separately.
drivers.definition: Combines the absolute reserve amount and the number of months of regular commitments it can cover.
drivers.evaluation: Both absolute wealth and coverage are considered. Operating funds, pledged deposits and unavailable assets are excluded from accessible personal reserves.
drivers.evidence: Verified savings and deposits after exclusions. Current-account operating balance is not automatically treated as personal savings.

drivers.name: Savings & Investment Progress
drivers.facts: ₹24,000 monthly savings retained · 4.2% rate · ₹25,000 investment contributions · contributions down 4%
drivers.assessment: The customer continues to retain savings and invest, although the rate remains below the configured profile benchmark.
drivers.definition: Combines retained monthly savings, savings rate and verified investment contributions into one view of asset-building progress.
drivers.evaluation: The assessment uses both rupee amounts and rates so customers with strong absolute saving are recognised without ignoring commitment-adjusted capacity.
drivers.evidence: Covered account transfers to recognised savings and investment destinations after internal-transfer deduplication.

drivers.name: Reserve Stability & Operating Resilience
drivers.facts: 84% of recent reserve high · 84% drawdown recovery · ₹7.80L operating liquidity · 0 low-balance days
drivers.assessment: Personal reserves have partly recovered after the July drawdown, while the operating account currently retains liquidity. The minimum operating requirement still needs confirmation.
drivers.definition: Combines reserve drawdown and recovery with operating-account liquidity, without counting operating funds as personal savings.
drivers.evaluation: Drawdown and recovery are treated as one event. Operating liquidity is reviewed separately to avoid double counting the same money across personal resilience and operating needs.
drivers.evidence: Monthly accessible-reserve balances and the identified operating current account. Required operating cash has not yet been confirmed by the customer.
